purpose: Construction attribute heavy unit appearance, drawn idle and walk poses, building metamorphosis key drawings
basePrompt: Create ONE production 2D game sprite animation atlas on a genuinely transparent background, a precise 4-column by 4-row grid of 16 equal square cells, no text, no grid lines, no shadows outside the character, no decorations. Use the supplied reference for character identity, palette, rendering and eye design. Every frame depicts the SAME redesigned heavy building-metamorphosis unit: very broad heavy barrel/bellied body, low center of gravity, substantial hips/base, squat small feet, slow ponderous personality, roughly 1.65x the normal body width and 1.18x height, NOT a scaled-up copy, NOT muscular or humanoid. Keep the friendly original dark dot eyes and species cues. Polished soft painted game sprite, dimensional shaded material, clean transparent alpha, neutral front 3/4 camera kept identical. Each cell uses the same scale and ground baseline (90% down cell); body centered at 50% X, safe padding. Row 1 cells 1-4: four consecutive subtly breathing heavy idle frames, same outline and volume. Rows 2 and 3 (8 cells left-to-right row-major): eight consecutive frames of a slow weighty waddling WALK IN PLACE, coherent alternating tiny foot contacts, body mass lags slightly, no translation across cell, seamless walk cycle. Row 4 cells 1-4: four chronological BUILDING METAMORPHOSIS KEY DRAWINGS: (1) the heavy unit braces, eyes close, compresses low; (2) torso swells sideways and feet merge into a spreading organic base, species crown folds; (3) features sink into a larger low rounded construction mass, forming vertical growth folds; (4) a wide grounded organic seed-foundation mound with subtle warm luminous cracks, no visible face or limbs, a clean continuation of the same body material, ready to grow into any building. These are functional in-game source sprites, NOT a preview/mockup/contact sheet. Consistency and exact cell registration matter. Avoid duplicate faces, side poses, floating feet, dramatic lighting, smoke covering shapes, white/checkered backgrounds, outlines of cells, labels, buildings drawn behind the actor.

bean.direction: Wide heavy pale bean-pod abdomen, substantial lower belly, original sprout leaves and eyes; leaves fold into the construction mass.

spore.direction: Broad squat cream barrel belly under a substantial red mushroom cap; cap folds and merges into the cream/red foundation.

pebble.direction: Dense warm faceted boulder, wide lower body and tiny stone feet; heavy rocking shuffle and geological foundation growth.

spring.direction: Large glossy translucent turquoise water-reservoir belly, low center of gravity, delayed tip sway; spreads into a water seed foundation.

processing: Each drawn actor was isolated by alpha connected components, registered to the shared ground pivot using one constant scale per species, then packed losslessly. Runtime interpolates matched silhouettes and material coordinates between drawn keys and the selected building. Existing ring and sparkle art supplies the secondary effects.
